item.description:
Madonna - Read My Lips (FIFA Promotional Single)

“Read My Lips” is a biligual dance-pop collabration between Madonna and Colombian star Feid, bleding sleek eletronic with Latin influences. The track combines infectious club rhythms with reggaeton textures while exploring themes of betrayal, self-respect, and refusing to be manipulated.

Madonna delivers sharp, defiant vocals as Feid responds with verses in Spanish, creating a dynamic conversation that gives the song emotional depth.
